narrative.overview: Clear, generous software presentation puts Sarah's actual work first. Neutral white, black, and cool gray combine with restrained blue interaction feedback, larger Traditional Chinese reading text, self-hosted Geist, and a generated S monogram. Light is the default, with a matching dark option. One real featured screenshot and explicit text selectors keep the work central.
keyCharacteristics: 18?20px reading text, 15?16px labels, and a 14px minimum at the default root size, including mobile.
48?56px controls with modest rectangular corners and 12px image containers.
An original generated S mark with source and derivative provenance.
Neutral stages, quiet depth, and subtle pointer feedback on real screenshots.

rules.name: The Role Rule
rules.body: Preserve theme-aware roles and readable contrast. Keep the interface neutral; reserve blue for meaningful interaction.

rules.name: The Readability Floor Rule
rules.body: Keep main prose at 18?20px and supporting text at least 14px at the default root size. Wrap before shrinking.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Let real artifact content supply complexity; keep interface structure flat and use the screenshot shadow sparingly.

dos: Do preserve readable text, wrapping, contrast, and generous controls on every viewport.
Do use public/brand/sarah-mark.png and retain public/brand/PROVENANCE.md with source and icon derivatives.
Do use real supplied screenshots and updated magnetic-chess imagery with provenance.
Do retain keyboard access, focus, explicit selection, and sticky dialog controls.
donts: Do not restore the rejected palette, decorative symbols, synthetic window decoration, or multi-image hero ornamentation.
Do not shrink supporting text below the established minimum to force a layout.
Do not substitute a generic library glyph for the generated S mark.
Do not invent titles, dates, stacks, employers, repositories, metrics, testimonials, or outcomes.
Do not use outdated image_original.png, autoplay, scroll hijacking, or motion that ignores user preferences.
